intro: Brother Sarno is an affable human cleric stationed at the entrance of the Cathedral of Light in Stormwind City. Serving as the primary greeter for worshipers and visitors, he also helps direct brave Alliance travelers toward engineers in Ironforge who need aid in reclaiming Gnomeregan.

sections.t: A Welcoming Voice in the Cathedral
p: Standing just inside the archways of Stormwind's magnificent Cathedral of Light, Brother Sarno is often the very first face pilgrims and travelers encounter. As a dedicated brother of the Church of the Holy Light, his role is simple yet vital: offering a kind greeting to anyone who enters the sacred hall seeking solace, prayer, or guidance. His warmth extends even to the most unexpected visitors, making him a reassuring presence amid the city's busy clerical life.

Beyond his pastoral greetings, Brother Sarno maintains communication with allies across the Alliance. When Tinkmaster Overspark in Ironforge urgently needed assistance dealing with his rogue invention, Techbot, deep within the irradiated halls of Gnomeregan, Sarno took it upon himself to guide capable adventurers toward Dun Morogh. Though a humble brother of the cloth, he understands that supporting the displaced gnomes is an act of genuine fraternity.
